rounds.name: Worker-Arden
rounds.text:

rounds.name: Worker-Kerr
rounds.text:

rounds.name: Worker-Flint
rounds.text:
By TRUSTING, we risk the worker cutting corners, but it also gives us a higher reward if they do the job properly. Withholding could yield more tasks but risks the worker cutting corners and potentially breaking faith.

ACTION: TRUST
